title: Steve Aoki & Bassjackers featuring Teddy Bee - Voices in My Head

lines.l: I hear your voice in my, I hear your voice in my
Feels like my head is underwater
Thoughts of you playing again and again
Falling apart, it's not what I wanted
Feeling you close, I hear your voice in my head
I hear your voices, I hear your voices
Remember in the first time I met you
